analysis: The proactive AI implementation in NEXUS has the structural foundation (proactive engine, screen monitor, screen.look tool, toast UI) but is missing critical pieces that make it feel like a chatbot rather than Ultron-level AI.

trigger_model.current: Proactive suggestions ONLY appear on screen.change events from screen monitor (passive)
trigger_model.gap: No continuous ambient awareness - no proactive monitoring of clipboard, notifications, window focus, system state, or user activity patterns
trigger_model.impact: AI only speaks up when pixels change significantly (>8%), missing context switches, errors, meetings, builds, deployments, messages arriving

action_execution.current: ProactiveToast action button only logs to console: console.log('Proactive action triggered:', action)
action_execution.gap: Action button does NOT invoke the tool via API - handleProactiveAct in App.tsx is a no-op stub
action_execution.impact: User clicks 'Describe screen' and nothing happens - the toast dismisses but no tool runs

voice_tts.current: Zero voice/TTS integration in proactive engine or toast
voice_tts.gap: No proactive.speaking event, no TTS for announcements, no voice personality
voice_tts.impact: Silent AI that only shows visual toasts - no 'Jarvis' voice presence

personality.current: Generic 'NEXUS has a suggestion' summary, technical 'Kind: screen.change' label
personality.gap: No personality layer - no tone, no contextual framing, no conversational warmth, no proactive voice
personality.impact: Feels like a system notification, not an AI assistant

screen_monitor.current: ScreenMonitor exists but defaults OFF (monitor_screen_enabled=false), requires ImageMagick for perceptual diff
screen_monitor.gap: Monitor not enabled by default, no auto-start on login, Wayland capture often fails without grim
screen_monitor.impact: Core trigger for proactive suggestions may not even be running

continuous_awareness.current: Only screen.change observations flow to proactive engine
continuous_awareness.gap: No clipboard monitoring for copied secrets/errors, no notification monitoring for alerts, no window focus tracking for context switches, no system monitor for CPU/disk/thermal alerts, no git/CI monitoring for build failures
continuous_awareness.impact: AI is blind to everything except pixel changes

tool_invocation_path.current: screen.look tool exists and works, tools/execute API exists, but frontend onAct handler doesn't call it
tool_invocation_path.gap: Frontend needs to POST to /api/tools/execute with tool name and params, handle permission flow
tool_invocation_path.impact: Complete disconnect between toast action and tool runtime

attention_model.current: Proactive engine has Attention class but no real events feed it (window.activity, voice.speaking don't exist on bus)
attention_model.gap: Engine's attention.activity stays 'idle', attention.speaking stays false - scoring rules for 'watching'/'call' demotion never trigger
attention_model.impact: Engine can't respect user focus state - may interrupt during calls/meetings

rate_limiting.current: RateGate exists (10min cooldown), screen_offer_cooldown=180s, quiet hours support
rate_limiting.gap: No learning/adaptive throttling, no user feedback loop to tune sensitivity
rate_limiting.impact: Fixed cooldowns either spam or miss important moments

suggestion_content.current: Only screen.change offers with hardcoded 'Describe screen' action
suggestion_content.gap: No suggestions for: clipboard secrets detected, notification alerts, build failures, high CPU, meeting starting, window context switch, error dialogs
suggestion_content.impact: Single trick pony - only offers screen description

1_enable_and_verify_screen_monitor.action: Set monitor_screen_enabled=true, monitor_screen_interval_seconds=30, install scrot/grim + ImageMagick

2_wire_toast_action_to_tool_execution.action: Replace handleProactiveAct stub in App.tsx with actual API call to POST /api/tools/execute

3_add_tts_for_proactive_announcements.action: Integrate Mistral Voxtral or system TTS in proactive engine _deliver()
3_add_tts_for_proactive_announcements.voice_events: Publish voice.speaking=true/false on bus for attention model
3_add_tts_for_proactive_announcements.personality: Add tone/personality layer - configurable voice, contextual phrasing

4_expand_observation_sources.clipboard_monitor: Already exists (ClipboardMonitor) - wire to proactive engine for secret/error detection
4_expand_observation_sources.notification_monitor: Already exists (NotificationMonitor) - wire for alert suggestions
4_expand_observation_sources.window_monitor: Already exists (WindowMonitor) - wire for context switch suggestions
4_expand_observation_sources.system_monitor: Already exists (SystemMonitor) - wire for resource alert suggestions

5_implement_attention_events.voice_speaking: Publish voice.speaking events from TTS/voice system

6_add_proactive_suggestion_types.clipboard_secret: Detect API keys, passwords in clipboard - offer to store in vault
6_add_proactive_suggestion_types.build_failure: CI/build fail detected - offer to analyze logs
6_add_proactive_suggestion_types.meeting_start: Calendar event starting - offer to prep notes
6_add_proactive_suggestion_types.error_dialog: Error window detected - offer to read/fix
6_add_proactive_suggestion_types.context_switch: Major app switch - offer relevant context

7_continuous_ambient_loop.action: Proactive engine should run continuous evaluation, not just event-driven
7_continuous_ambient_loop.interval: Every 30-60s evaluate full context (screen + clipboard + notifications + system + windows)

8_personality_and_voice.voice: Mistral Voxtral HTTP (base64 WAV) or Piper/Coqui local TTS
8_personality_and_voice.personality_config: Tone: professional/friendly/minimal, Verbosity: terse/normal/chatty, Proactivity: passive/balanced/aggressive
8_personality_and_voice.contextual_phrasing: Templates per suggestion kind with variable interpolation

9_permission_flow_for_proactive.current: Tool execution requires permission, but proactive toast doesn't handle it
9_permission_flow_for_proactive.needed: Auto-show PermissionDialog when proactive action triggers permission-required tool
9_permission_flow_for_proactive.ux: Toast action -> permission dialog -> tool runs -> result shown in toast or activity

10_feedback_learning_loop.action: Track user accept/dismiss/ignore rates per suggestion kind
10_feedback_learning_loop.adapt: Auto-tune cooldowns, thresholds, enable/disable kinds based on behavior
10_feedback_learning_loop.explicit: User can say 'stop suggesting X' or 'suggest X more'

current_working_pieces: ProactiveSuggestion type in nexus.tsx with action tool/params/label
proactive.suggestion bus event published from engine
ProactiveToast component in primitives.tsx with action button
Toast mounted in App.tsx above screens
Proactive engine with scoring, RateGate, quiet hours, held suggestions
screen.look tool captures screen, sends to vision model, returns description
Tool registry with verifiers, capabilities, availability probes
blocking_issues: handleProactiveAct in App.tsx is a console.log stub - THE critical disconnect
ScreenMonitor defaults OFF - no observations without manual enable
No TTS/voice integration anywhere in proactive path
Attention model fed by zero real events
